changes: Both ev_render_out handlers (the recording follower and Retrig Grid's) are now short entries that call the unchanged bodies only when they have work, so an idle audio block no longer builds a 144-byte stack frame; on the author's unit the two cost 3.4 µs a block before and 2.5 µs after. Recording, the grid and the RTRG key are unchanged.
stockPolicy: No firmware or stock-derived code/tables are present. Addresses, lengths and SHA-256 guards are metadata; exported instructions and sections are authored module code. Local materialized recipes and firmware are never committed.
